content:
Casey L: FYI got invoice INV-AG-3321 from AtlasGrid for $32,400. No PO on the header and vendor name shows as 'Atlas Grid USA' (Coupa has 'AtlasGrid, Inc'). PDF: https://s3.company/atlasgrid/INV-AG-3321.pdf
Priya M: Is there any chance this ties to PO 135900? I see that PO was created for the Atlas pilot but it was only for $25k.
Renee S: PDF line items: $25,000 "pilot fixed fee" + $7,400 "compute overage". So it looks like same situation as others: PO covers fixed fee, overage is separate.
Tom H: PO 135900 status: APPROVED, amount $25k, remaining $0. Procurement: can you confirm mapping to PO 135900?
procurement-bot: PO 135900 status: APPROVED. Suggest action: request vendor reissue invoice split or provide written confirmation tying $25k to PO 135900.
Casey L: Vendor didn't include PO# and used a slightly different legal name. That prevents auto-match. Can we accept vendor email confirmation or require reissue?
Priya M: For >$10k we prefer reissue. But if vendor provides a signed confirmation and procurement approves, finance can do a manual match and route for Director approval. Director Mei needs to sign for exceptions over $30k.
Renee S: Total invoice is $32.4k so cross threshold. If we split and pay $25k separately we avoid Director escalation. Ask vendor to reissue two invoices: $25k with PO on header and $7,400 overage separately.
Tom H: Business sponsor (ML infra) says they need the fixed fee paid this week or onboarding delays. Can procurement fast-track the confirmation email if vendor can't reissue in time?
procurement-bot: Procurement can confirm mapping in writing to finance if vendor refuses to reissue, but we need vendor to sign that confirmation or provide a formal remit note. Suggested wording prepared.
Casey L: I'll ping vendor: "Please reissue INV-AG-3321 as: 1) Invoice A $25,000 referencing PO 135900 on the header; 2) Invoice B $7,400 for compute overage with usage detail. If you cannot reissue within 48hrs, please reply with a signed confirmation tying the $25k line to PO 135900."
invoices-bot: Invoice INV-AG-3321 uploaded to NetSuite (NS-INV-21009). Status: "On Hold - PO Missing". Notified: finance-approvers.
Priya M: Also ask vendor to correct legal name to match Coupa or provide EIN/W-9 to avoid vendor master mismatch. That'll save future headaches.
Tom H: Vendor replied: "We can issue two invoices tomorrow and will add PO# on the $25k invoice. We'll attach the usage CSV for the overage."
Casey L: Great. Ask them to CC finance@redwood and procurement. Once reissued, Samir can code and NetSuite should auto-match the $25k.
Renee S: If reissue is delayed, procurement please send your written confirmation and tag Director Mei for expedited approval of the manual match.
Director - Mei: Noted. I'll review the manual exception if it comes to me, but prefer split invoices to avoid exception.
Priya M: I'll keep monitor and update NetSuite once docs are in. Leaving thread open until reissued files are attached. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
